name: Generation Ships
description: An early-game crisis: once the first empires reach tech level 3, a giant world ship and its escort arrive at the galaxy edge, scout a populated colony and, a year and a half later, demand it. Four kinds of arrival (Pilgrims, Heirs, Ark Faith, the Quiet Ship), each with its own story and choices. Cede the world, offer another, or fight.
